question.prompt: In \(463.03\), what is the whole-number part, and how many hundredths are in the fractional part? Enter those two numbers in order, separated by a comma.

solutions.title: Split at the decimal point
solutions.explanation: The digits to the left of the decimal point give \(463\). The digits to the right give \(\frac{3}{100}\), or \(3\) hundredths.
